a2-09-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Have You Seen the Beach?
a2-09-01.scenario: At the language exchange, Daniela talks about the beaches of Vietnam. You want to know whether she has ever visited a beach there.
a2-09-01.prompt: Ask Daniela whether she has ever visited the beach.
a2-09-01.english: Have you ever visited the beach?
a2-09-01.canDo: I can ask whether someone has ever had an experience using alguna vez.

a2-09-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Never by the Sea
a2-09-02.scenario: Lucía asks whether you have ever visited the little village by the sea. You have never been there.
a2-09-02.prompt: Tell Lucía that you have never visited the village.
cues: Say what you have never done
a2-09-02.english: I have never visited the village.
a2-09-02.canDo: I can say that I have never had an experience using nunca.

a2-09-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Port for the First Time
a2-09-03.scenario: On the way to the coast, you and Kaylee talk about ports. You want to know if she has ever been to one, and you have never been to a port yourself.
a2-09-03.prompt: Ask Kaylee whether she has ever been to a port, then say that you have never been to one.
cues: Say you have never been to a port
a2-09-03.target: ¿Has estado alguna vez en un puerto? Nunca he estado en un puerto.
a2-09-03.english: Have you ever been to a port? I have never been to a port.
a2-09-03.canDo: I can ask and answer experience questions with alguna vez and nunca.

a2-09-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Seafood by the Sea
a2-09-04.scenario: In a restaurant by the sea you ask Meg whether she has ever tried seafood, and you tell her that you have never taken an excursion to the sea.
a2-09-04.prompt: Ask Meg whether she has ever tried seafood, then say that you have never taken an excursion to the sea.
cues: Say what you have never done
a2-09-04.target: ¿Has probado alguna vez el marisco? Nunca he hecho una excursión al mar.
a2-09-04.english: Have you ever tried seafood? I have never taken an excursion to the sea.
a2-09-04.canDo: I can talk about experiences by the sea using familiar experience questions.

a2-09-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Souvenir from the Market
a2-09-05.scenario: At the market in the coastal village, you ask Meg whether she has ever bought a souvenir, and you tell her that you have bought one today.
a2-09-05.prompt: Ask Meg whether she has ever bought a souvenir, then say that you have bought one today.
cues: Say what you have bought today
a2-09-05.target: ¿Has comprado alguna vez un recuerdo? Hoy he comprado un recuerdo en el mercado.
a2-09-05.english: Have you ever bought a souvenir? Today I have bought a souvenir at the market.
a2-09-05.canDo: I can ask about and describe experiences during a trip to the beach.

a2-09-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Fish and Seafood
a2-09-consolidation.scenario: In a restaurant by the sea, Carlos asks you whether you have ever tried fish. You have never tried it, and you want to ask him about seafood.
a2-09-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have never tried fish, then ask him whether he has ever tried seafood.
cues: Say what you have never tried
a2-09-consolidation.target: No, nunca he probado el pescado. ¿Has probado tú alguna vez el marisco?
a2-09-consolidation.english: No, I have never tried fish. Have you ever tried seafood?
a2-09-consolidation.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about experiences.
